name: upmods
description: Minecraft mod updater and cross-loader migration TUI powered by Modrinth
author: 0png

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/cli.tsx --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/shims/react-devtools-core.ts --banner:js="import { createRequire as __upmodsCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __upmodsCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --sourcemap
scripts.test: tsx --test src/args.test.ts src/state/reducer.test.ts src/state/workflow.test.ts src/utils/display.test.ts src/utils/modrinth.test.ts src/utils/viewport.test.ts
